rows.en: Yamato: "Come on, what are you doing?!
Hurry up and get changed!"
Touya: "Shut up... I only just got back,
and I'm tired."
Yamato: "Hey! Is that any way to talk?!
I don't remember raising you like that!"
Touya: "...I don't remember you raising me at all."
Yamato: "Coming! Come on in."
Melvi: "Huh? Big Brother, you haven't changed yet?
Big Sister, Daddy and Mommy are already... Hmm? What is it?"
You're incredibly cute!
That looks pretty good on you.
Melvi: "Th-Thank you..."
Yamato: "Really, if she's like this already, I can't wait to see her in a few years..."
Touya: "Yeah. She's plenty cute the way she is, though."
Melvi: "It's okay. There, there.
Big Brother! Don't pick on Yamato-chan! Bad boy!"
Touya: "But she was..."
Melvi: "It's a party, so let's all
have fun together. Okay?"
Touya: "O-Okay, fine."
Melvi: "Then hurry up and get changed.
Melvi's going on ahead!"
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Melvi: "Ehehehe. That makes me happy.
But Melvi isn't the one you should be saying that to."
Touya: "Huh?"
Melvi: "You're nice to everyone, Big Brother,
but that can hurt the person you care about most.
A girl's feelings are very complicated, you know."
Touya: "Melvi... Who are you quoting?"
Melvi: "Oh, you caught me? Actually, Mommy said it."
Yamato: "Oh, is that all? You surprised me."
Melvi: "Big Brother, if you don't get changed soon, you'll be late.
Melvi's going on ahead!"
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Touya: "...Looks like everyone's already gone."
Yamato: "Didn't Melvi tell you just now?
Anyway, let's hurry."
Touya: "But the big shots from Agarthia and Zigrim
are coming, right? We're obviously just an afterthought."
Yamato: "What are you talking about? We're practically
the guests of honor at tonight's party!"
Touya: "You think so?"
Yamato: "Whatever you think, let's get going."
Yamato: "Who could it be? ...Come in."
Celica: "Good evening! ...Achoo!"
Touya: "Oh, Celica..."
Celica: "Honestly, making a lady come and fetch you
is hardly gentlemanly behavior."
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Celica: "? Wh-What?"
Touya: "Oh, no... It's just, a dress like that...
it looks good on you..."
Celica: "D-Does it? Thank you...
...I'm happy."
Yamato: "Really, you look so much more grown-up.
You can pull off this sort of outfit too, Celica. What a surprise!"
Celica: "You could've left out the surprise, but thank you... Achoo!"
Yamato: "Huh? Have you caught a cold?"
Celica: "No. Maybe it's because I was out in the night air.
But I'm fine. Let's head to the party."
Touya: "...Celica, hold on a second."
Celica: "Huh? What?"
Celica: "Oh..."
Yamato: 'Nicely done, Touya.
Draping your jacket over her shoulders.
You can be considerate when you want to.'
Touya: 'H-Hmph.'
Celica: "...Thank you, Touya."
Touya: "O-Okay, let's go."
Celica: "...Okay."
Clovis: "Hey, finally awake, are you...?
Oh? What's with you two lovebirds?"
Arthur: "Draping your own jacket over her shoulders...
I didn't know you did things like that, Touya."
Touya: "S-Shut up..."
Clovis: "Oh, he's embarrassed."
Touya: "...Shut up."
Arthur: "Hahaha. But things will be difficult for you from here, Touya.
Won't there be all sorts of obstacles
to having your relationship accepted? Those inflexible elders, for example..."
Clovis: "But Touya's going back to his own world, right?
In that case..."
Arthur: "Clovis!"
Clovis: "...Oh."
Celica: "N-No, it's okay... Don't worry about it.
I know that. And even so... it's okay."
Touya: "Celica..."
Clovis: "W-Well, it's not like he's leaving right away,
so there's no need to get so serious..."
Arthur: "That's not helping.
Anyway, today is a day to enjoy ourselves.
We can think about what comes next when the time comes."
Celica: "...You're right."
Arthur: "...And the signing ceremony this afternoon went smoothly.
There still seems to be some friction at the lower levels,
but the leaders have reconciled, so it looks like we'll have
peaceful days for a while."
Touya: "For a while... huh."
Clovis: "To rid humanity of fighting, we'd probably have to become herbivores.
As long as we hunt to satisfy our appetites,
well, it's not happening."
Arthur: "I doubt that's the only factor, but as long as we keep living
the way we do, yes."
Touya: "Enough, enough. There's no point dwelling on that.
We'd probably just end up with Debish's
way of thinking anyway."
Clovis: "True. For now, let's enjoy tonight's party
to the fullest."
Arthur: "We're guests, so apart from being bombarded with questions by the ladies,
I think we can relax and enjoy ourselves."
Clovis: "That's the part I'm looking forward to.
A one-night romance isn't so bad, you know.
How about it, Touya? You could..."
Celica: "Hey, don't go putting strange ideas into Touya's head."
Clovis: "All right, all right. Leave the ladies to me.
You two can spend some sweet time together."
Celica: "H-Honestly..."
Arthur: "Oh, by the way, Ymir was looking
for you."
Celica: "Huh? Ymir was?"
Arthur: "Apparently she wants to talk a little about what comes next...
I think she's in Lady Ivel's room now."
Celica: "What could it be...?"
Touya: "Go and see her."
Celica: "Huh? But..."
Touya: "It could be important, right?
Don't worry. I'll be right here waiting."
Celica: "Okay... I'll be back in a little while, then."
Clovis: "Well, the party should be starting soon.
We'd better get going too."
Touya: "Yeah."
Yamato: "Well, we might want to hurry a little..."
Touya: "Hold up a second.
Hey, what's that purple object?"
Yamato: "Huh? Oh, you're right. It's wandering around the house...
It's definitely a person... Wait,
isn't that Aurelie?"
Touya: "Now that you mention it... But something seems different about her."
Yamato: "Let's call out to her, anyway."
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Aurelie: "Oh, what should I say...?
Hey! I've come to get you... No, that's not right...
I should be more ladylike...
Touya, I've come to fetch you. Shall we go...? Somehow,
that sounds so fake... Hmm, I should act cute...
...Here I am♥ Aah! No, no! I'm giving myself goose bumps."
Touya: "...Hey, what are you doing?"
Aurelie: "Eek!"
Touya: "Whoa! Th-That was close..."
Aurelie: "Oh, Touya... S-Sorry... I just reacted..."
Touya: "A backfist with a twist is dangerous, you know. Honestly...
You nearly...?! H-Hey... That outfit..."
Aurelie: "Huh...? Oh, d-don't stare at me like that..."
Touya: "S-Sorry..."
Aurelie: "...It doesn't suit me after all... does it?"
Touya: "N-No, I think it does..."
Aurelie: "You're lying. Then why won't you
look at me properly?
It really doesn't suit me..."
Touya: "That's not it..."
Aurelie: "It's okay. A dress just isn't for me..."
Touya: "I said that's not it! That dress looks good on you.
At least, I think so."
Aurelie: "...Then why...?"
Yamato: "But it really does look wonderful on you."
Aurelie: "D-Does it? Thanks, Yamato-chan."
Touya: "B-By the way, why were you wandering around
the house?"
Aurelie: "Huh? Th-That's...
You were taking so long to come, Touya, I got worried...
But I didn't know what to say..."
Yamato: "So you were rehearsing."
Touya: "You could've just said you'd come to get me
without doing all that."
Aurelie: "You say that, but when the moment comes,
I start thinking about all sorts of things..."
Touya: "Aurelie. Do you remember our promise?"
Aurelie: "...Yes. 'Be honest about my feelings,' right?"
Touya: "Right. I'm happy you care about all that,
but let's relax a little more around each other.
I'll try too."
Aurelie: "...Okay."
Touya: "Right, then... Ahem.
Aurelie, that dress looks wonderful on you.
And you look very beautiful today..."
Aurelie: "...Pfft, ahahahahaha!"
Touya: "Wh-What?!"
Aurelie: "Hahaha... That doesn't suit you!
That version of you sounds like he's trying much too hard, Touya."
Touya: "...Tch."
Aurelie: "Hahaha... Hah, hah...
...But thank you... I'm happy..."
Touya: "!!"
Aurelie: "Well then, shall we go?"
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Maki: "Wow... How daring!
That outfit is definitely going to provoke a crime."
Aurelie: "Really? Is it that sexy?"
Maki: "Aurelie, I thought you'd prefer something
more no-nonsense. So you wear things like this too.
But it looks really good on you."
Aurelie: "Hehehehe, thank you."
Touya: "...So, why are you wearing your usual clothes?"
Maki: "Huh? Because I wasn't invited."
Yamato: "What?! Does that mean... you sneaked in?"
Maki: "Don't make it sound so bad...
At least call it 'ambush reporting.'"
Touya: "Same difference. You could get in normally
without all that, couldn't you? You could ask Rest..."
Maki: "Oh, that won't work.
Reporting is forbidden at this party.
I can't get exclusive footage any other way."
Aurelie: "You're a born scoop hunter..."
Maki: "Don't flatter me so much. You're embarrassing me."
Fain: "Aha! So this is where you were!"
Maki: "Urk, Fain-chan."
Fain: "Come on, give it a rest!
When you cause trouble, Maki, you're making things difficult for my master!"
Maki: "Rest doesn't mind little things like that."
Fain: "No means no. Even if I have to use force..."
Maki: "Ugh... Oh! Fain-chan.
Look, look at the lady next to you."
Aurelie: "Next to him...? Me?"
Fain: "...Hmm?"
Aurelie: "H-Hey!"
Fain: "..."
Aurelie: "...?"
Fain: "...Hah!"
Maki: "Oh dear, it seems Fain-chan found that a bit
too stimulating."
Touya: "You know..."
Maki: "Well, I'll make myself scarce before I get caught.
I'll leave the rest to you. Let's go, Reisuke!"
Reisuke: "Beep!"
Yamato: "Oh... She's gone..."
Fain: "U-Ugh..."
Aurelie: "H-Hey... What should we do about Fain?"
Touya: "For now..."
Maki: "Oh, I forgot to tell you one thing."
Maki: "Ymir was looking for you earlier."
Aurelie: "Huh? For me?"
Maki: "She said something about your future plans...
Anyway, she asked you to come to Lady Ivel's room,
so why don't you go and see her? See you!"
Aurelie: "What could she want...?"
Touya: "Go and see her."
Aurelie: "Huh? Won't you come with me?"
Touya: "I can't just leave this guy here, can I?
Don't worry. I'm not going anywhere.
Besides, it doesn't sound like she was looking for me."
Aurelie: "...All right. I'll be back in a little while.
I'll come right back."
Touya: "Yeah."
Yamato: "...Well then..."
Fain: "U-Ugh... Hah!"
Yamato: "Oh, he's back."
Fain: "Wh-Where am I...? Oh! Where's Maki?!"
Touya: "She ran off ages ago."
Fain: "Damn her... I'll catch her, no matter what!!"
Yamato: "...He's certainly lively... Hmm? There seems to be
a crowd over there.
Could the party be starting?"
Touya: "Let's go and have a look."
Touya: "Well then..."
Kururu: "Boo!"
Touya: "Whoa!"
Kururu: "You're late! I'm tired of waiting!"
Touya: "D-Don't suddenly jump at me from behind..."
Kururu: "But you were taking so long to come out, Touya.
I waited all this time because I wanted to show you, Touya."
Yamato: "How long have you been waiting?"
Kururu: "Hmm... Since a little before it got dark, I guess.
I was hiding and waiting when Ymir and the others came out,
so I thought it wouldn't be much longer..."
Touya: "S-Sorry. I didn't think you'd come
to fetch me..."
Kururu: "It's okay. We got to see each other like this.
Besides, waiting made my heart race,
and that was pretty fun."
Touya: "I-I see."
Kururu: "Hey, hey, more importantly... How do I look?"
That's a cute dress.
You're the one who looks good, so anything would suit you.
...Hasn't your hair gotten longer?
Yamato: 'Honestly! Why don't you compliment the girl wearing it?!'
Touya: '...Oh.'
Yamato: 'Honestly, you have no idea how a girl feels!'
Touya: 'S-Shut up...'
Kururu: "...Right? I really like this dress too."
Yamato: '...Huh?'
Touya: 'She seems perfectly happy.'
Yamato: 'W-Well, everyone's different...'
Kururu: "? What's wrong?"
Yamato: "N-No. It's nothing."
Kururu: "Well, it's going to start soon, so let's go."
Touya: "Yeah, you're right."
Kururu: "...Huh?"
Touya: "Well, I mean, you're cute, Kururu, so..."
Kururu: "Pfft... Ahahahahaha!"
Touya: "...?"
Kururu: "Hahaha... Oh, that's funny!
What are you saying all of a sudden with such a serious face?! Ahahahaha!
You're so strange!"
Touya: 'Did I say something funny?'
Yamato: 'Hmm... Looks like it's still a bit too soon for that with her.'
Kururu: "Hahaha... Hah, hah..."
Touya: "Was it really that funny?"
Kururu: "S-Sorry, sorry."
Touya: "...Honestly..."
Kururu: "...But thanks for the compliment.
Come on, let's go to the party!"
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Kururu: "Huh?"
Touya: "Well, I was asking if it's gotten longer
than before you tied it up like that."
Yamato: '...Y-You idiot! Why are you saying that at a time like this?!'
Touya: 'Huh? Aren't you wondering about it?'
Yamato: 'W-Well... Yes, but...
There are other things you should be saying...'
Kururu: "...Has it? I can't really tell..."
Touya: "N-No, never mind. Don't worry about it."
Kururu: "Okay. I understand.
Hey, shouldn't we head to the party soon?"
Touya: "Yeah, you're right."
Yamato: 'Lucky for you she's so easygoing.
Normally, you'd have made her angry.'
Touya: 'Yeah. I'll be more careful next time...'
Clovis: "Oh, finally decided to show up?
You certainly took your time."
Touya: "Sorry about that. Anyway, what happened with
the signing ceremony and all that?"
Arthur: "It went smoothly. There still seems to be
some friction at the lower levels, but the leaders of the Kingdom of Agarthia
and the Zigrim Republic have reconciled,
so it looks like we'll have peaceful days for a while."
Touya: "For a while... huh."
Clovis: "To rid humanity of fighting, we'd probably have to become herbivores.
As long as we hunt to satisfy our appetites,
well, it's not happening."
Arthur: "I doubt that's the only factor, but as long as we keep living
the way we do, yes."
Touya: "Enough, enough. There's no point dwelling on that.
We'd probably just end up with Debish's
way of thinking anyway."
Clovis: "True. For now, let's enjoy tonight's party
to the fullest."
Arthur: "We're guests, so apart from being bombarded with questions by the ladies,
I think we can relax and enjoy ourselves."
Clovis: "That's the part I'm looking forward to.
A one-night romance isn't so bad, you know.
How about it, Touya? You could..."
Kururu: "You lecher."
Clovis: "Haha, hahaha... I-I'm kidding. Just kidding.
You have such a cute partner already."
Arthur: "Oh, by the way, Ymir was looking
for you."
Kururu: "Huh? Me?"
Arthur: "I think she's in Lady Ivel's room now."
Kururu: "What could it be?"
Touya: "Go and see her."
Kururu: "But..."
Touya: "It could be important, right?
Don't worry. I'll be right here waiting."
Kururu: "Okay, got it. I'll be back in a little while."
Clovis: "Well, the party should be starting soon.
We'd better get going too."
Touya: "Yeah."
Touya: "...Aaaah! It's finally over!"
Yamato: "Opening your mouth so wide. Such bad manners."
Touya: "What do you expect? After a speech that long,
of course I'm sleepy. Why are speeches by big shots
always so damn long, anyway?"
Yamato: "What are you talking about?
You hardly listened to a word..."
Lodis: "It is true that the higher one's social standing,
the longer one's speech becomes."
Yamato: "Oh, Lodis! And Prince Tix too..."
Lodis: "...We were able to reach this day
because of all you have done.
On behalf of the people, I thank you."
Touya: "It's not like that. We just gave things a push.
You're the one who made it happen, Lodis, through the efforts
of all the people here as well."
Lodis: "Hahaha. You are modest.
Some see you as a hero for piloting Rayblade and defeating Goderius,
you know."
Touya: "Heroes are just an illusion people create.
Everyone is special."
Lodis: "I see. There is truth in that."
Tix: "...The war is over, and the ≪Ze=Ode≫
have fallen. But... Is everything really over now?"
Yamato: "Dr. Debish disappeared along with Goderius, after all.
I'm sure things will be okay."
Lodis: "All that remains is to dismantle Rayblade
and seal away the 'Core.'"
Yamato: "You really are going to dismantle Rayblade, then."
Touya: "Does that mean you won't analyze it anymore?"
Lodis: "No, we've finished that for the time being.
We have established that only someone with Lenis Enroad's genetic information
can start it up.
And only through synchronicity with a compatible person of the opposite sex
can it be fully activated."
Yamato: "I see. It's the 'red thread of fate.'"
Lodis: "Hahaha. Perhaps.
But that isn't the only reason for dismantling it.
Even with you, its sole pilot, returning to your own world,
if we leave it as it is, someone else in a later age,
if not us, might think to use it for military purposes.
We must take precautions."
Touya: "My own world... Can I go back?"
Lodis: "If Dr. Wenimas's goal was to stop Debish,
now that the goal has been achieved,
your existence should no longer become unstable when you return."
Touya: "Should...?"
Lodis: "Well, if it doesn't work, you can simply come back here.
You would be welcome."
Touya: "Hey, come on..."
Lodis: "Hahaha. I'm joking. We take responsibility for getting you home.
We are preparing the device now. Don't worry.
You should be able to return tomorrow.
The others should be receiving the explanation too."
Yamato: "I see... So it's finally time to say goodbye to this place."
Tix: "So take your time and enjoy today... Though,
I suppose that's not my place to say."
Touya: "Of course you can say it. Yeah. I'll enjoy myself."
Sisk: "Your Highness!"
Lodis: "Ugh... Th-That voice..."
Sisk: "Your Highness! Where are you?"
Lodis: "W-Well, I shall excuse myself now..."
Sisk: "! Found you, Your Highness♥
Hey! Why are you running away?! Your Highness!"
Tix: "Maybe it's about time my brother settled down."
Touya: "You seem awfully happy about it."
Tix: "Of course. What younger brother wouldn't be happy for his older brother?"
Touya: "A brother... huh. Yeah."
Tix: "Yes. Well then, I shall excuse myself too.
See you later..."
Yamato: "Well, there's no point just standing around
in a daze. Let's walk a little."
Yamato: "...Isn't that Leone?"
Touya: "Hmm? Oh, you're right. Hey!"
Leone: "...? Oh!"
Leone: "...So this is where you were. I was looking for you."
Yamato: "You got a dress ready too, Leone."
Leone: "Yes. Bart had it prepared for me."
Yamato: "It looks wonderful on you. And the color is lovely.
Right, Touya?"
Touya: "Y-Yeah. That sort of outfit suits you too."
Leone: "Ehehehe, thanks.
...Hearing you say that makes me happy..."
Touya: "H-Hey, are you okay? You look like you're in pain...
Don't push yourself..."
Leone: "...Okay. Sorry for worrying you.
But... I want to spend as much time with everyone as I can..."
Touya: "You can see us tomorrow too. There's no need to push yourself, right?"
Leone: "...I'm okay, really.
...See? Just like this. Right?"
Touya: "As long as you're okay..."
Leone: "...Rather than worrying about me, Touya,
isn't there someone else you should be worrying about more?"
Touya: "Huh?"
Leone: "...The person you care about, Touya.
Don't worry about me. Go and find her."
Touya: "But..."
Leone: "Touya, a girl is happiest when she feels
that the person she loves is thinking of her. I'm sure she's waiting for you, Touya,
to come and find her."
Touya: "Is that how it works? Still, I didn't know you knew so much
about that kind of thing. You're really well informed."
Leone: "...Huh? Now that you mention it, you're right.
Bernst must have put that knowledge into me."
Touya: "Oh... Sorry..."
Leone: "No, don't worry about it. Knowing those things
let me feel this way. I could learn
how wonderful it is to love someone..."
Touya: "Leone..."
Leone: "You know, Ai-chan told me the other day
that a girl's first kiss is something
special."
Touya: "R-Really..."
Leone: "Hey, Touya. You took my first kiss,
so you'd better take responsibility♥"
Touya: "What?!"
Yamato: "Oh dear, looks like your bachelor days are over, Touya."
Touya: "Hey, not you too..."
Leone: "...Just kidding. It was a joke.
You did that to save me, after all.
Thank you. It's because of you that I can
be here like this, Touya. I'm grateful."
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Leone: "Well then, I'd better get going.
I want to talk to the others too..."
Yamato: "Huh? You haven't seen them yet?"
Leone: "No. I wanted to see you first, Touya...
Oh, th-there's no deeper meaning to that.
W-Well, I'll be going. Bye-bye."
Touya: "Leone..."
Yamato: "Hey, Touya. She was acting cheerful,
but she was really pushing herself.
It looked like she was forcing a smile through the pain."
Touya: "Yeah... She was probably trying not to worry us...
That's just like her..."
Yamato: "Hey, what good will it do for you to get gloomy too, Touya?
Come on, let's not just stand here."
Touya: "Yeah, you're right..."
Head somewhere less crowded.
Head toward the crowd.
Stay where you are.
Fores: "Oh..."
Touya: "You're... if I remember right..."
Yamato: 'Lieutenant Colonel Fores Mishual.'
Touya: "...L-Lieutenant Colonel Fores Mishual...?"
Fores: "I'm honored that you remember me..."
Yamato: "Huh? You seem different somehow..."
Touya: "Isn't it because she's wearing her hair down?"
Yamato: "Hmm, it's more like... a certain allure,
or a softer, more feminine air..."
Fores: "Am I being complimented?"
Yamato: "Y-Yes!"
Touya: "...Huh? Come to think of it, where's
that guy who was always with you?"
Fores: "...He... That idiot... died..."
Yamato: "What?!"
Fores: "...In my arms..."
Touya: "I-I see... I'm sorry."
Fores: "His body was already falling apart...
Right to the end, I couldn't
do anything for him..."
Touya: "...I don't think that's true."
Fores: "Huh?"
Touya: "He looked really happy when he was with you.
Well, it's not like I knew him that long,
but that's how it looked to me."
Fores: "...Yes. I'm a dull woman, devoted only to military duty,
but he told me he loved me...
I regret not returning his feelings sooner."
Touya: "But Reamond breathed his last
in your arms, right?"
Fores: "Yes... It was just like falling asleep."
Touya: "Then he must have been happy. He was able to spend his final moments
in the arms of the woman he loved.
It's a cliche, but you have to live for Reamond too
and be happy.
I think that's what Reamond would want."
Fores: "Hehehe... You're right.
Besides... Perhaps our parting is only temporary..."
Touya: "Hmm? Why are you holding your stomach? Does it hurt?"
Fores: "No, it's nothing.
Well then, I shall excuse myself."
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Yamato: "...Perhaps Reamond hasn't died,
but has 'returned'..."
Touya: "? What do you mean?"
Yamato: "Nothing.
Anyway, let's go somewhere else."
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Touya: "Hmm? This looks like the same scene as before..."
Yamato: "Does it? You must be imagining it. Yes."
Touya: "Really...? ...Hmm?"
Yamato: "Huh? Isn't that General Growster?"
Touya: "What's he looking at with that glass in his hand?"
Yamato: "The royal capital of Agarthia is in that direction..."
Growster: "Dilma...
This is that fifteen-year-old Raidol you liked..."
Adjutant: "Your Excellency. The night air is bad for your health..."
Growster: "...He was stubborn and inflexible,
but he rose all the way to Marshal, and then he died..."
Adjutant: "..."
Growster: "Had he waited a little longer, I would have caught up...
Selfish to the very end."
Adjutant: "Marshal Revios... He was your closest friend, wasn't he?"
Growster: "Hmph! That man was no friend of mine!
Not a man who couldn't even keep a promise..."
Adjutant: "Your Excellency..."
Yamato: "He looks as if something serious is on his mind...
We should probably leave him alone."
Touya: "Yeah... We'd better go somewhere else."
Yamato: "Oh... The person over there is..."
Touya: "Who is that?"
Yamato: "What are you talking about?!
She's a knight of York... No, the new queen,
Ciel!"
Touya: "Huh? Oh, yeah... Now that you mention it..."
Yamato: "Oh, she's noticed us.
Touya, make sure you greet her properly."
Touya: "I'm not a kid. I know that much."
Ciel: "Good evening. Huh? Are you alone?"
Touya: "Yeah. I'm looking for her now."
Ciel: "I see."
Touya: "You really helped us back there. Thanks."
Ciel: "No, I didn't do anything.
Father and the others were the ones who helped you directly."
Touya: "Well, that's true..."
Ciel: "Besides, we only did what was right.
We owe York's liberation
to you too."
Touya: "I appreciate you saying that.
Even if you're just being polite, it makes me happy."
Ciel: "Hehehehe... I mean it."
Touya: "By the way, is it okay for the queen to be here alone?"
Ciel: "Father is with Lady Ivel and the Zigrim councilors,
discussing the future."
Touya: "Hey, is it okay for you not to be there?"
Ciel: "It's fine. Father can go through at least that much trouble.
It's his punishment for keeping secrets from me all this time."
Touya: "I don't think that's the issue..."
Reduce: "Your Majesty! So this is where you were!"
Ciel: "Oh, Reduce. What's wrong?"
Reduce: "What do you mean, what's wrong?
How could the ruler of a nation
slip out of the talks?!"
Ciel: "What's the problem? They're boring."
Reduce: "Your Majesty..."
Touya: "Hey, you've got your work cut out for you."
Reduce: "Ah, Touya.
I've heard of your exploits. Just as I'd expect of you."
Touya: "It's not like that.
Besides, what you taught me came in handy."
Reduce: "Heh... That was the result of your talent and effort.
I did nothing."
Tyron: "Hey, is this really the time for a leisurely chat?"
Reduce: "Oh! ...Your Majesty?"
Tyron: "Her Majesty escaped quite a while ago."
Reduce: "What?! That woman..."
Tyron: "You still have much to learn.
At this rate, she'll have you under her thumb."
Reduce: "Wh-Wh-What are you saying?!"
Tyron: "Did you think no one had noticed?
Well, your immediate task seems to be
telling her how you feel."
Reduce: "M-Mind your own business!
Touya, we shall take our leave now.
Until we meet again! Let's go, Tyron!"
Tyron: "Yes. I'll be going as well.
...Touya. Her Majesty Queen Alforina was not mistaken
to entrust the crystal to you.
I intend to devote myself to ensuring that such a tragedy never happens again.
I am indebted to you. Even when you return to your own world,
keep that noble heart of yours."
Touya: "Yeah. You too."
Tyron: "Yes. Farewell!"
Yamato: "...They all have a lot of hard work ahead of them."
Touya: "Yeah.
But the winds of change are blowing in a good direction."
Yamato: "Oh, that was nicely put.
What's gotten into you? Have you got a fever?"
Touya: "...Shut up."
Yamato: "Hehehehe...
Well then, let's go somewhere else."
Touya: "Yeah."
Yamato: "Huh? What's that crowd over there...?"
Touya: "Who knows? More importantly..."
Rishuna: "E-Excuse me... Oh."
Touya: "Hey, Rishuna. What's wrong?"
Rishuna: "I don't like being surrounded by people..."
Yamato: "Then that crowd is..."
Rishuna: "Yes. Valga is being bombarded with questions now.
Our true identities are not public, but our role as Shinkaio's
pilots is known..."
Rishuna: "Oh, more importantly, I saw Celica earlier.
She looked rather troubled..."
Touya: "Celica? Do you know where she went?"
Rishuna: "She walked toward the fountain..."
Yamato: "Touya."
Touya: "Yeah. Thanks, Rishuna. See you later."
Rishuna: "Yes. Please be sure to accept
the feelings of the person who loves you."
Touya: "Yeah. See you."
Yamato: "Oh, there she is...
Look, in front of that fountain..."
Touya: "Okay, let's go...? What's wrong, Yamato?"
Yamato: "...Go on your own, Touya."
Touya: "Yamato?"
Yamato: "I'll stay out of it this time.
Or are you nervous about going alone?"
Touya: "It's not that... All right.
I'll be back in a little while."
Yamato: "Okay."
Touya: "Celica."
Celica: "Oh..."
Touya: "So this is where you were.
...What's wrong?"
Celica: "Touya... Is it true you're going back tomorrow?"
Touya: "...Y-Yeah. I haven't decided for sure yet,
but I guess I'll end up going back..."
Celica: "I see..."
Touya: "Celica..."
Celica: "Touya... Are you okay with that?"
Touya: "Huh...?"
Celica: "I see... So you're okay with it.
When you said you loved me, that was a lie..."
Touya: "Hey..."
Celica: "It must have been! How can you say you're going back?!
If you loved me, you couldn't do that, could you?
I... I don't want to be separated from you, Touya!"
Touya: "It's not like this is goodbye forever..."
Celica: "How... How can you say that?!
Once you go back there... You won't be able
to come here so easily..."
Touya: "Celica..."
Celica: "No! Don't touch me!
Touya, you're... You're..."
Touya: "...I didn't fall in love with you on a whim, Celica.
That's not how I feel."
Celica: "You're lying!"
Touya: "I'm not lying. Why won't you believe me?
What's wrong? This isn't like you."
Celica: "I... I never thought I'd say things like this either.
But I can't help it..."
Touya: "Celica, listen to me..."
Celica: "...Forget it... Just..."
Touya: "Wait a second!"
Celica: "No! Let go!"
Touya: "Listen to me!"
Celica: "Forget it! I don't want to hear it!"
Touya: "..."
Celica: "Wh-What...!! ...Mmm..."
Touya: "...Can you still not believe me?"
Celica: "..."
Touya: "Celica?"
Celica: "...That's not fair. If you do that,
I can't stay angry anymore..."
Touya: "..."
Celica: "...I really do love you, Touya...
I can't hate you... I don't want to part with you, but...
But... I don't want you to hate me, Touya..."
Touya: "...So when did I ever say I wasn't coming back?"
Celica: "...Huh?"
Touya: "I told you I didn't fall in love with you on a whim, right?
I'll go back there and explain things properly
to the person waiting for me. Then I'll come back here."
Celica: "R-Really?"
Touya: "Yeah. It's a promise."
Celica: "...Thank goodness...
...I'm sorry. I'm being awful, aren't I...?"
Touya: "That's not true."
Celica: "Hey... Once more..."
Touya: "No."
Celica: "Aww, why?"
Touya: "Let's save the rest for when I come back.
It'll give us something more to look forward to."
Celica: "Look forward to... Honestly, Touya."
Yamato: "W-We've got trouble!"
Touya: "Y-Yamato?! What happened...?"
Yamato: "I'm telling you, it's serious!! Look, over there!"
Touya: "Over there...? What's in the sky...!!"
Celica: "Huh...? No way..."
Aurelie: "...Touya, have you got a moment?"
Touya: "Oh, Aurelie. What's wrong?"
Aurelie: "...Just a moment."
Touya: "Y-Yeah. See you later, Rishuna."
Rishuna: "Yes. Please be sure to accept
the feelings of the person who loves you."
Touya: "What?! Y-Yeah..."
Rishuna: "Huh? Aren't you going with them?"
Yamato: "I'll stay out of it this time."
Rishuna: "I see... You're like his big sister."
Yamato: "More or less!"
Touya: "Hey, where are we going?"
Aurelie: "..."
Touya: "Hello?"
Touya: "...Hmm? A fountain... It's quiet here."
Aurelie: "..."
Touya: "Hey, what's wrong?"
Aurelie: "...I suddenly felt worried..."
Touya: "Worried?"
Aurelie: "You're going back tomorrow too, aren't you, Touya?"
Touya: "Huh...? Y-Yeah... Probably."
Aurelie: "We're here in the same place now,
but once we're back, I'll be in France and you'll be in Japan, Touya..."
Touya: "..."
Aurelie: "It's far away."
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Aurelie: "Hey, why don't we stay?
We have a place for ourselves here too,
and even if we go back, there's nothing..."
Touya: "Aurelie."
Aurelie: "What is it?"
Touya: "Don't say that.
Don't say something so sad as there's nothing for you there."
Aurelie: "..."
Touya: "Compared to life here,
our own world might be boring. But aren't there
people there who matter to you?"
Aurelie: "People who matter to me..."
Touya: "Yeah. The people back where you grew up,
the orphanage director who raised you, and the children...
Don't they matter to you? Of course they do, right?"
Aurelie: "That's..."
Touya: "Going back doesn't mean we'll never see each other again.
We'll be on the same Earth."
Aurelie: "But..."
Touya: "If we really love each other, distance doesn't matter.
Our hearts will be closer to make up for it.
...I love you, Aurelie."
Aurelie: "Touya..."
Touya: "H-Hey, don't cling to me... Let go, will you?"
Aurelie: "...No."
Touya: "Hey..."
Aurelie: "I want to feel you here with me while I can, Touya.
Then I think I can bear it a little better."
Touya: "Aurelie..."
Yamato: "W-We've got trouble... Whoa! Sorry..."
Touya: "Y-Yamato?! What happened...?"
Yamato: "Huh?! Oh! I'm telling you, it's serious!!
...Look, over there!"
Touya: "Over there...? What's in the sky...!!"
Aurelie: "No way..."
Rishuna: "Oh, more importantly, I saw Kururu-chan earlier.
She looked rather troubled..."
Touya: "Kururu? Do you know where she went?"
Rishuna: "She walked toward the fountain..."
Yamato: "Touya."
Touya: "Yeah. Thanks, Rishuna. See you later."
Rishuna: "...Please be sure to accept
the feelings of the person who loves you..."
Yamato: "Oh, there she is...
Look, in front of that fountain..."
Touya: "Okay, let's go...? What's wrong, Yamato?"
Yamato: "...Go on your own, Touya."
Touya: "Yamato?"
Yamato: "I'll stay out of it this time.
Or are you nervous about going alone?"
Touya: "It's not that... All right.
I'll be back in a little while."
Yamato: "Okay."
Touya: "Kururu."
Kururu: "Oh... T-Touya!"
Touya: "Kururu... You..."
Kururu: "I-It's nothing. Wh-What's wrong?"
Touya: "..."
Kururu: "Honestly, don't worry about me... I'm completely fine."
Touya: "...No, you're pushing yourself. Are you going to lie to me?"
Kururu: "..."
Touya: "Kururu."
Kururu: "...Oh dear... I'm not this weak...
I'm not supposed to be this weak..."
Touya: "Kururu..."
Kururu: "When I heard you were going home, Touya...
When I thought of being separated from you, Touya...
Ehehehe... I should be happy for you, shouldn't I?
I'm not supposed to be this selfish..."
Touya: "I see... It's true, I'm going back to my own world.
But that's because this world taught me how important 'feelings' are.
There's someone waiting for me back there,
and I can't betray that person."
Kururu: "...I know. That's why... But..."
Touya: "..."
Kururu: "But I still don't want this! I'm coming with you!"
Touya: "H-Hey..."
Kururu: "I've decided! I'm going to your world too, Touya!"
Touya: "...What about Grad and Thora?"
Kururu: "That doesn't matter! I want to be with you, Touya!
Daddy and Mommy don't matter!"
Touya: "!"
Kururu: "Tou... ya..."
Touya: "Kururu... Agarthia and our world
are connected. It would probably be easy for you to come with us.
But is it okay to leave those two behind,
to leave behind the parents who love you?!
Family bonds are more important than that, aren't they?
Don't say they don't matter..."
Kururu: "...Ugh... I-I'm sorry..."
Touya: "Kururu. Maybe people go through life
leaving all sorts of things behind. But there are some things
you must never throw away.
...You understand, don't you?"
Kururu: "...Okay."
Touya: "...Sorry for hitting you. Does it hurt?"
Kururu: "No. This is the second time you've hit me...
I... I couldn't even understand something like that...
You'll hate me if I'm like this, won't you, Touya...?"
Touya: "People aren't as capable as they think they are.
You only begin to grow up
when you realize how little you understand. You've learned that.
So it'll be okay. Besides, there's no way I could hate you,
is there?"
Kururu: "...Really?"
Touya: "Yeah. And who said I wasn't coming back?
There are lots of people I care about here too. I'll definitely come back.
And I'll come and see you. I promise.
So... Will you wait for me until then?"
Kururu: "...Okay. I'll wait."
Yamato: "W-We've got trouble!"
Touya: "Y-Yamato?! What happened...?"
Yamato: "I'm telling you, it's serious!! Look, over there!"
Touya: "Over there...? What's in the sky...!!"
Kururu: "Huh...? That..."
